lines.english: Mm…

lines.japanese: んん……？
lines.english: Mmm…?

lines.japanese: なん……だろう……夢？
lines.english: What… is this…? A dream?

lines.japanese: 「えと……あ、あれ？」
lines.english: “Um… Oh. What?”

lines.japanese: この景色は、グレタガルド……かな？　だよね？
lines.english: This landscape was… Gretagard, perhaps? Yes, surely?

lines.japanese: 「そっか、いつの間にか召喚されてたんだ……」
lines.english: “I see. I was summoned here without even realizing it…”

lines.japanese: 僕は込みあげてくる喜悦を隠さず、口元に笑みをたたえたまま目を閉じた。
lines.english: I made no attempt to hide the joy welling inside me. With a smile still upon my lips, I closed my eyes.

lines.japanese: 意識を切りかえよう。
lines.english: Time to switch myself over.

lines.japanese: ここはグレタガルド。
lines.english: This was Gretagard.

lines.japanese: 僕は聖騎士ホーク。黄金の鷹ホーク・シアンブルー。
lines.english: I was the holy knight Hawk. Hawk Cyan-Blue, the Golden Hawk.

lines.japanese: よし。
lines.english: Good.

lines.japanese: あらためて目を開ける。
lines.english: I opened my eyes anew.

lines.japanese: 「ややっ、ここはグレタガルド辺境のナハト大森林！　そうか、私は召喚されたのだな」
lines.english: “What ho! The Great Forest of Nacht, on the far frontier of Gretagard! I see. I have been summoned.”

lines.japanese: あらためて声を張る。
lines.english: I projected my voice anew.

lines.japanese: 太古の神々の恨みと、厚く折りかさなった枝葉とによって、一切の陽光を遮られている呪われた密林。
lines.english: A cursed jungle where the hatred of primeval gods and layer upon layer of heavy boughs denied passage to every ray of sun.

lines.japanese: 方々で鳥獣のわめきが響きわたっている。湿気と土の香と草いきれに、胸やけがしそうだ。
lines.english: The cries of birds and beasts resounded on every side. The damp, the smell of earth, the steaming breath of vegetation—it was enough to turn the stomach.

lines.japanese: 「何故このような未開の地に……召喚主は王宮付きではないな……？」
lines.english: “Why summon me to such an uncivilized place…? My summoner cannot belong to the royal court…”

lines.japanese: 私は胞子類の吸入を警戒して、口元を抑えながら呟いた。
lines.english: Wary of inhaling spores, I murmured behind one hand.

lines.japanese: だが異なる物質界──つまり羽田鷹志のいる世界──への干渉は、古来より硬く禁じられてきたはずだ。一般の術士には許されていない。
lines.english: Interference with another material plane—the world inhabited by Takashi Haneda—had been strictly forbidden since ancient times. No common mage was permitted it.

lines.japanese: 王宮の召喚術士が国命を受けて私を呼ぶのは、あくまで有事の際の超法規的措置。国家レベルの危機に瀕したときのみに許される例外に過ぎないのだ。
lines.english: A royal summoner called me by order of the crown only in an emergency, as an extralegal measure. It was a mere exception, permitted solely when the nation faced a crisis.

lines.japanese: 見れば足元には、召喚に用いたのであろう魔方陣が描かれている。そういえば私は魔法とかにもそこそこ詳しい設定だったので、それが森の禍々しい力を流用した黒魔術なのだと都合よく理解することができた。
lines.english: At my feet, I now saw the magic circle presumably used in the summoning. As my established character happened to know a respectable amount about magic, I conveniently understood it to be black sorcery fueled by the forest’s accursed power.

lines.japanese: 「畏れずに出てきなさい、そこの術士よ」
lines.english: “Come forth without fear, mage who hides nearby.”

lines.japanese: 私は木陰に潜む小さな気配へ呼びかけた。
lines.english: I addressed the faint presence concealed in the shade of the trees.

lines.japanese: 「我は弱き民の支援者ホーク・シアンブルー。禁呪をもって異界の扉を開いた責、相応の故あらば咎めはしない」
lines.english: “I am Hawk Cyan-Blue, champion of the weak. If sufficient cause compelled you to open a gate between worlds through forbidden arts, I shall not condemn you.”

lines.japanese: 「誠にございますか」
lines.english: “Do you speak truly?”

lines.japanese: 呪われた木々の幹よりずっと細い体が、すうっと染みでるように現れた。私は大聖剣グレタカリバーの柄に手を置いて……すぐに下ろした。
lines.english: A body far slimmer than the trunks of the accursed trees appeared as though seeping out of their shadows. I placed a hand upon the hilt of the holy greatsword Gretacalibur… then promptly lowered it.

lines.japanese: 「本当だ。元来、法とは秩序を守るためのもの。秩序を乱す法ならば本末転倒、無用の長物だと私は考える。いま君は、私にすがることでしか秩序を守れないのだろう？」
lines.english: “I do. Law exists to preserve order. A law that disrupts order defeats its own purpose; I consider it a useless relic. At this moment, you can preserve order only by turning to me. Is that not so?”

lines.japanese: 「噂どおりの洞察力とお人柄、感服いたします救世主さま」
lines.english: “Your insight and your character are all the rumors promised. I stand in awe, my savior.”

lines.japanese: 「ホークでいい。君は？」
lines.english: “Hawk will do. And you are?”

lines.japanese: 「私はやましなみや──」
lines.english: “I am Yamashina Miya—”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　なに山科さん、いまなんて言ったの？」
lines.english: “What? Yamashina, what did you just say?”

lines.japanese: 「私はナハト村のスパロウと申します」
lines.english: “I am Sparrow, of Nacht Village.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう……ではスパロウとやら、だいぶ魔術の腕が立つようだが、どこのアカデミー所属だ？」
lines.english: “Indeed… Well then, Sparrow, you appear to possess considerable magical skill. To which academy do you belong?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、今はどこにも」
lines.english: “At present, none.”

lines.japanese: 非認可の魔法使い──ふむ、いわゆる妖術師か。しかし森の力を土台にしているとはいえ、召喚術ほどの高等魔法を単身で行使できるのだから、その技量はかなりのものと見える。
lines.english: An unlicensed practitioner of magic—hmm. What was commonly called a sorcerer. Yet even drawing upon the forest’s power, the ability to perform an art as advanced as summoning single-handed revealed considerable skill.

lines.japanese: 「なぜアカデミーに通わない」
lines.english: “Why do you not attend an academy?”

lines.japanese: 「規律や団体行動が苦手なのです。恐怖を感じると言っても過言ではありません」
lines.english: “I fare poorly with rules and group activities. It would be no exaggeration to say they inspire terror in me.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、うん、分かるよ。それはよく分かる」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah, I get it. I really get it.”

lines.japanese: 「だろうね。私たち、似たもの同士だし」
lines.english: “I’m sure you do. You and I are alike.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、私は社交的で友人も多い方だが、いいだろう、いまは君の力になりたい」
lines.english: “No, I am sociable and possess a great many friends. But very well. At present, I wish to lend you my strength.”

lines.japanese: 「いいの？　私なんかのために」
lines.english: “You would? For someone like me?”

lines.japanese: 「なに言ってるんだよ山科さん、僕ら似たもの同士じゃないか。グレタガルドでぐらい助けあっていこうよ」
lines.english: “What are you talking about, Yamashina? You and I are alike, aren’t we? In Gretagard, at least, let’s help each other.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ、頼もしいこと言うんだね委員長」
lines.english: “Hee hee. How reassuring, Class Rep.”

lines.japanese: 「鷹志でいいよ。あ、間違った。ホークでいい、なんなりと話してくれ」
lines.english: “Call me Takashi. Ah, no, that was wrong. Call me Hawk. Tell me whatever troubles you.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、慈悲深きホーク卿。実はいま私の村が、敵の一個小隊から襲撃を受けているのです」
lines.english: “Yes, merciful Sir Hawk. The truth is, my village is presently under attack by an enemy platoon.”

lines.japanese: 「敵……それは“翼ある軍勢”だな」
lines.english: “The enemy… The Winged Host.”

lines.japanese: 私はスパロウがうなずくより早く剣を抜いていた。
lines.english: My sword was drawn before Sparrow could nod.

lines.japanese: 「そうです。何十もの翼人兵が、嘲笑うかのように村の上空を旋回しています。すでに戦士たちはほとんど斃れ、残された我々の壊滅も時間の問題なのです」
lines.english: “Yes. Scores of winged soldiers circle over the village as though mocking us. Nearly all our warriors have fallen. The destruction of those who remain is only a matter of time.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだって！　それは大変だ、早く救援に向かわねば。僕はいつだって誰かの力になりたいんだ」
lines.english: “What! This is serious. We must hurry to their aid. I always want to help people.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとうございます、頼もしきホーク卿。この御恩は生涯忘れません」
lines.english: “Thank you, valiant Sir Hawk. I shall remember this kindness all my life.”

lines.japanese: 「鷹志でいいってば。気にしないでよ。僕はいつだって誰かの力になりたいと思ってるし、それに、なんかあいつら嫌いなんだ。死んじゃえばいいのに」
lines.english: “I told you, Takashi is fine. Don’t worry about it. I always want to help people, and besides, I kind of hate those guys. I wish they’d all die.”

lines.japanese: 「きつーい。委員長、意外と溜めこんでたんだね」
lines.english: “Harsh. You had more bottled up than I expected, Class Rep.”

lines.japanese: それは晩秋の風に翻弄される木の葉のごとく──
lines.english: Like leaves at the mercy of a late-autumn wind—

lines.japanese: ──翼ある者たちが、苦悶の呻きを漏らしながら降下してくる。
lines.english: —the winged creatures descended, groaning in agony.

lines.japanese: 眼を剥きだし、喉を掻きむしり、頭を振りみだしながら、一体ずつゆらゆらと降りてくる。
lines.english: Eyes bulging, throats clawed raw, heads thrashing, they drifted down one by one.

lines.japanese: 「ハアーっ！」
lines.english: “Haaah!”

lines.japanese: 私は刃をふるう。
lines.english: I swung my blade.

lines.japanese: 醜い生首が宙を舞う。
lines.english: An ugly severed head danced through the air.

lines.japanese: 「正義のためにっ！」
lines.english: “For justice!”

lines.japanese: 非情に徹して刃をふるう。
lines.english: I hardened my heart and swung again.

lines.japanese: 聞くに耐えない断末魔は聞かなかったことにする。
lines.english: I decided that the death scream too awful to bear had never reached my ears.

lines.japanese: 「ロイヒテン・グレタ！」
lines.english: “Light upon Gretagard!”

lines.japanese: 大聖剣グレタカリバーの強靭な刃を、膂力のかぎり深々と敵の体に埋めこむ。
lines.english: With all my strength, I buried the mighty blade of the holy greatsword Gretacalibur deep in the enemy’s body.

lines.japanese: 相手が槍を構えるいとまも与えず、問答無用で叩ききる。
lines.english: Before the creature could ready its spear, I struck it down without warning or mercy.

lines.japanese: 「死ね死ね死ね死ね死ねぇー！」
lines.english: “Die, die, die, die, diiiie!”

lines.japanese: 殺戮の鬼と化して亡骸の山を築く。
lines.english: Transformed into a demon of slaughter, I built a mountain of corpses.

lines.japanese: 見たか！　貴様らなど、空にさえいなければ私の敵ではないのだ！
lines.english: Behold! So long as you were not in the sky, none of you were a match for me!

lines.japanese: 「次ッ！」
lines.english: “Next!”

lines.japanese: 返り血をぬぐいながら、小屋の陰に潜むスパロウを振りかえった。
lines.english: Wiping away the blood that had spattered me, I looked back at Sparrow, hidden behind a hut.

lines.japanese: 「我、常夜の森の意思に代わり命ず。始原の日より萌ゆる藻、祖たる胚、幾兆幾京を経て那由他の果てへ」
lines.english: “I command thee in the name of the will of the Forest of Eternal Night. Algae sprung from the primal day, ancestral embryo, through trillions and tens of quadrillions, unto numbers beyond reckoning.”

lines.japanese: 妖術師が呪詛の言葉を結ぶと、彼女の手の中で触媒が砕けちる。
lines.english: As the sorcerer completed her words of malediction, the catalyst shattered in her hand.

lines.japanese: 無数の砕片が風にのって空高くのぼると、次の瞬間、目標に選ばれた間抜けな犠牲者が野太い悲鳴をあげてひらひら降りてくる──いや、落ちてくると言うべきか。
lines.english: Countless fragments rode the wind high into the sky. An instant later, the foolish victim chosen as their target gave a deep-throated scream and came fluttering down—or rather, came plummeting down.

lines.japanese: スパロウの妖かしの術が、敵の体内に毒性の細菌を送りこみ、爆発的に繁殖させたのだ。この術に直接的な殺傷力はないが、対象は丸三日ほどひどい下痢と嘔吐に悩まされることとなる。
lines.english: Sparrow’s sorcery had introduced toxic bacteria into the enemy’s body and caused them to multiply explosively. The spell possessed no direct power to kill, but its target would suffer terrible diarrhea and vomiting for three full days.

lines.japanese: やつは地面の上で私たちに尻を向け、ばしゃばしゃと滝のような吐瀉物を巻きちらしている。
lines.english: On the ground, the creature presented us with its rear while splashing out a waterfall of vomit.

lines.japanese: 「よし、あとは任せるんだ！」
lines.english: “Good. Leave the rest to me!”

lines.japanese: 私は大聖剣グレタカリバーと祝福されし盾グレタバリアーを手に、颯爽と物陰から踊りでた。
lines.english: With the holy greatsword Gretacalibur in one hand and the blessed shield Greta Barrier in the other, I sprang gallantly from behind cover.

lines.japanese: 「おまえたち、いつもいつも高いところから見下ろして！　何様のつもりだ！」
lines.english: “You people are always looking down on everyone from on high! Who do you think you are?”

lines.japanese: 荒地に膝まづいていた敵を、背中から一突き。
lines.english: I stabbed the enemy kneeling on the blasted earth once through the back.

lines.japanese: 「頭が高いんだよ！　這いつくばれ！　這いつくばらんか！」
lines.english: “How dare you hold your head so high! Grovel! Grovel before me!”

lines.japanese: それからぴくりとも動かなくなるまで、何度も何度も突きおろした。
lines.english: Then I stabbed down again and again until it no longer twitched.

lines.japanese: 恐ろしい翼人兵が薄汚い遺体に変わると、私もまたすぐにスパロウが身を寄せる小屋の陰へと退避する。
lines.english: Once the terrifying winged soldier had become a filthy corpse, I too immediately retreated behind the hut where Sparrow sheltered.

lines.japanese: 「ふう。上首尾だな、私の発案した個別撃破および一撃離脱作戦は。もはや残る敵もおらぬようだ」
lines.english: “Whew. A resounding success, this plan of mine—pick them off one at a time, then retreat after each strike. It seems no enemies remain.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、お見事でした。さすがは都でも名高い、黄金の鷹ホーク・シアンブルー。まこと勇者の名に恥じない、惚れ惚れする戦いぶりでした」
lines.english: “Indeed, it was magnificent. Just as one expects of the Golden Hawk, Hawk Cyan-Blue, whose name is celebrated even in the capital. A battle worthy of a true hero. I was utterly entranced.”

lines.japanese: 「惚れ惚れ……そ、そうかな……」
lines.english: “Entranced… D-do you mean it…?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。さすがだね委員長」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. Impressive as always, Class Rep.”

lines.japanese: 「やだな山科さん、そんな、おだてないでよ」
lines.english: “Oh, Yamashina, please. You don’t have to flatter me.”

lines.japanese: 「まさか。ここは羽田君の理想の世界なんだから、都合のいいことはぜんぶ真に受けちゃっていいんだよ」
lines.english: “I’m not. This is your ideal world, Haneda. You’re allowed to take every convenient thing at face value.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうか。じゃあ、山科さんが惚れ惚れするって言ったのも、都合よく解釈しちゃっていいのかな」
lines.english: “Oh, that’s right. Then when you said you were entranced… am I allowed to interpret that in the most convenient way too?”

lines.japanese: 「いいんじゃない？　現実の世界はそうそう思い通りに運ばないからね。夢の中でぐらい幸せに浸らなきゃ、生きていく気力さえなくなっちゃうよ」
lines.english: “Why not? The real world almost never goes the way you want. If you don’t let yourself be happy in your dreams, pretty soon you won’t even have the will to live.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、そうだよね、山科さんいいこと言うなあ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Yeah, that’s a great point, Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「ホ、ホーク卿！」
lines.english: “S-Sir Hawk!”
“What!?”

lines.japanese: とつぜんスパロウの悲鳴のような声がほとばしった。咄嗟に顔を上げた私は、そこに見た──
lines.english: Sparrow’s voice suddenly burst forth in something like a scream. I jerked my head up and saw—

lines.japanese: ──彼女の後方、上空から矢を番えている敵の姿を。
lines.english: —behind her, in the sky, an enemy fitting an arrow to its bow.

lines.japanese: ぎりぎりと引きしぼられる弓弦。あやまたずスパロウの左胸に向けられた矢尻。高みから見下ろすいやらしい目。
lines.english: The bowstring drawn taut with a creak. The arrowhead aimed unerringly at Sparrow’s left breast. The loathsome eyes gazing down from on high.

lines.japanese: させるものか。私はなんとしても彼女を守るのだ！
lines.english: I would not allow it. Whatever it took, I would protect her!
